answer_1.quote: We evaluate our proposed method on the Ubuntu IRC benchmark ... Experimental results show that HeterMPC outperforms ... achieving a new state-of-the-art performance for response generation in MPCs.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to multi‑party conversation contexts

answer_2.quote: We used the evaluation package ... including BLEU‑1 to BLEU‑4, METEOR and ROUGE‑L, which was also used in this paper.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation was conducted to measure the quality of the generated responses in terms of three independent aspects: 1) relevance, 2) fluency and 3) informativeness. Each judge was asked to give three binary scores for a response ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators (three graduate students) scored each response on relevance, fluency, and informativeness using binary scores (0 or 1) for each aspect.
